John Ware was our javelin man and he threw up to his early season form but 158'4" was not good enough for a place in that class of competition.

Both Percy Porter and John Ware did well in finishing 3rd and 2nd in the hammer and javelin respectively. Jim McGrath led in the long jump until the final round where two competitors"pulled one out of the bag".

Our last track man Ray Middleton walked well to close-in fourth with 15:31.2 in the 2 mile walk. It was annoying to see only one field-events man but John Ware threw well to record fourth in the Javelin with 158'2½".
Jim Heathfield ran his fastest half of the season finishing 3rd in 2:02.2, while John Ware finished 2nd, 3rd and 5th in the shot, discus and Javelin events.

John Ware has shown small improvement with a personal best of 169'10½" gaining second place in the Vancover Trophy, but is inconsistent.
